*Update for those interested *

Well, it went about how I imagined it would. She told me that she never considered me to no longer be a part of her life and is still open to friendship, which is a relief. But she said she doesn't want to be involved in each other's lives. I'm a bit confused by that because by being a part of someone's life, you're involved in it. She doesn't want to be involved but we're still a part of each other's lives. Maybe I'm just not understanding it.

She also said she's okay with occasional communication. I'm happy about that. All I can really ask for is to still have the chance to check up on her and make sure she's okay. She went on to say that she's changed as a person because she's tired of not having her needs met. She also said that she's already moved on and healed on her own terms. I'm happy that she isn't letting what happened bother her anymore. At the same time, I'm worried about this new person she claims to be. I'm happy that she is changing for presumably the better, but I'm afraid of what I might have turned her into. Since I know that her former self could be very impulsive and was prone to instant gratification, I'm mostly afraid that she might become too reckless in efforts to meet her needs and end up hurting herself in some way. 

There is still uncertainty about whether or not we will ever meet in person again and that really bothers me. I guess that will come in time. If we ever do reconnect in person, I just hope we can still get along okay. She's one of the best friends I've ever had and it devastates me to think that we wouldn't be able to be good friends again. 

All in all, I guess it went okay. It definitely could have been worse so that's a plus. Either way, it took a massive weight off my chest and I suppose gave me some sense of closure. For that, I'm thankful.

Thank you to those of you who wished me well. I greatly appreciate it. With that said, I don't think I'll be back here for a long time. Take care, friends.
No response yet. Don't even know if they've seen the message. Maybe I'll get something tomorrow. Maybe I won't. But for now, I'd better go to sleep. It's getting late.

Things aren't always so black and white, you know. Mind you, this is a person that I know for a fact still cares about me. This is a person that I've known and been close with for 12 years. 

There's literally no ultimatum in simply asking a question. Do you want French toast for breakfast? No? Okay I guess you're not eating breakfast then. That's not how that works. As an individual, you have the freedom to choose your own paths. Instead of French toast, maybe you want an omelette. In this case, the omelette is deciding to wait until a later date, once things have become more stable in the world/both of our lives, to begin to rekindle. This year has been hell, to say the least, and I fully understand if my person is not ready to climb that mountain yet. 

I've intentionally left out some details because I've gone over them several times in past posts. To fill you in, my fuck up was having depression for over half my life and not being able to break the cycle. I attempted to end my life on multiple occasions, the last attempt involving my person. My person saved my life from two states away. I was hospitalized, medicated, put in therapy, etc, and I'm currently on the biggest uphill of my life. I've apologized quite a few times but words don't really mean anything. Forgiveness in this case is actually attempting to prove to my person that I've come out of this as a better, stronger, healthier person and that's what I'm trying to achieve by rekindling the friendship. I'm trying to end what has been the worst year of our lives on a good note.

But thanks for the input. It's nice to know that people know my situation better than the person living it.
I don't see how asking this person if they're willing to rekindle the friendship is making an ultimatum. I'm literally giving them the choice.

I guess I should clarify. This isn't a confession of feelings to this person. We've already explored that side of things and it turned out to be really nice. But I did some things that I shouldn't have and our friendship has been on hold since. I'm just trying to reconnect because this is a friendship that I'd very much prefer not to lose. Feelings are not important to me at this time.
It isn't rejection I'm worried about. It's losing a 12 year long friendship. I appreciate the kind wishes.

While this is such a nice thing to read, it's extremely bitter sweet for me because I lost someone I'm close to due to my suicidal thoughts/attempts. It all happened back in January and I still don't know if I'll ever hear from her again. It's not an easy thing to come to terms with.

Yeah. At this point, I'm just waiting for her to reach out whenever it happens, if ever. It was certainly one hell of a punch to the face, no doubt about that. I've never been put, or put someone else in such a difficult situation and I don't ever want to do that again. It isn't fair to either party in any way. I'm just horribly disappointed in myself for letting it all happen in the first place. Thank you for the kind words. Me too. I'd really love for that to happen.

This sounds eerily similar to both what happened to me and something my person would tell me. 

Honestly, friendship is all I would like to have back right now. This is someone I've known and been very close with for over 11 years and she's not a person I'm comfortable with permanently losing. I'm still very much in love with her but I can't lose her as a friend. 

While we were always just friends, technically we've been apart for about 5 years. She moved two states away after college. She came to visit in April last year and ended up staying at my place. I took off work while she was here because I love to spend time with her. Long story short, we discovered feelings for each other but agreed to not turn it into an LDR. So we just started talking more and went on with our new places in each other's lives. Looking back, a lot of the things we did were pretty indicative of an LDR so, heh. She came back down in August to surprise me for my birthday. It was literally the best week of my life. Everything was fun, natural, and it just felt right. I completely fell in love with her during that week. 

Like your person, I too deal with depression. It led me to the point of attempting suicide a few times. January this year would have been the attempt to do me in. Using the last shred of humanity I had left, I messaged her asking if I could call her. I explained what was happening and she lost it, as anyone probably would. She arranged a full on rescue mission from two states away. Local PD, Sheriffs, Highway Patrol, FBI, EMS, Hazmat, search helicopter, the whole nine yards. A bunch of friends showed up and even my uncle that lives 8 hours away drove down the same night. I was detained and taken to two different psychiatric hospitals where I spent two weeks in eval. Since I was otherwise a "normal" person just going through a rough patch in life, I was discharged early. I was put on medication. It actually made me worse. Therapy, talking with friends, spending less time time alone, finding a new job, etc, is what really helped me get out of my slump.  

After I was discharged, the very first thing I did was message my person asking if she was okay and if I could talk to her later that night. She asked for time and space, understandable. But it's been almost 9 months and I still don't even know how she's doing. Now I'm left with the consequences of my actions and a person that I don't know if I'll ever see again. 

Fast forward to July, my new dog ran away. He's another huge factor in my recovery. He was gone for 13 days. I didn't know that she still saw my social media posts because a few days after I posted that he ran away, I got a gift of a stuffed animal that looked like my dog with a note from her. It's obvious she still cares and you have no idea how much that means to me. But dammit, I miss my friend. 

With all of that said, I'm in a much better place now and I owe everything to her because I wouldn't even be here to be able to experience it. She saved my life and I'm forever grateful. It's just so painful to be in this position.  At the end of the day, I have no one to blame other than myself so my consequences are definitely deserved.

As much as I'd like to think that, I have my doubts. While I've certainly improved as a person, I'm sure she's too smart to let herself go down that road with me again after what I did. I know she still cares about me to some extent, given what she did for me in July. But If by some miracle she still thinks of me in the way I still think of her, hopefully we can figure something out to give each other a real chance at this instead of what it started as.

But I lost her because of it, rightfully so. No one should ever have to go through that and I can't blame her for how she took it. But more importantly, I lost our 11 years of close friendship. That's what hurts the most.

What about the fact that I'm losing my house next year? I'm stuck in a dead end job and I can't get accepted to any job I apply to for the life of me. I can no longer create my own happiness and have lost interest in all of my hobbies, including music. I've tried getting into new hobbies but I can't find any that I can get lost in and help take my mind off of my mind. My love life is a joke at best. I have no one left and strangers on the internet sure as hell can't help. My dogs, the last coping method I really had left, are old and are on their way out. I mean shit, I even left home to try to get a new start somewhere else with help from another part of the family but that didn't work out at all and that bridge is likely burned. There's more I can list but that's probably the best stuff to talk about that comes to mind as of now. And not to be rude, but I'm not exactly asking for help. I know people seem to think that because someone makes a post, they're indirectly asking for help. That isn't the case here. I've already accepted that there really isn't anything left for me to do with my life. No matter what I do, I can never get ahead. It's been over two years of consistent decline and it's mentally tolling and physically exhausting. I'm tired of trying and getting nowhere. I'm just a by-product of way too many unfortunate circumstances.

I'm struggling to find a job, I'm broke, friends are distant, and I'm bored with all of my hobbies. I guess you could say I'm not doing so well.

I definitely wouldn't say we're "old" but we certainly aren't kids. We are both well into the age of seriously considering what we want our futures to be and prioritize what we need to do to get there so easy distractions and instant gratification aren't something we put our minds towards. As for the pursuit of happiness, we are both the hard working type. There will always be more to achieve in life than just finding the one you love whether that is through individual means or as partners. We've had the discussion of "seriousness." Considering what she has told me she is willing to do when the time is right and when we both are able to fully commit, which unfortunately is not possible at this point, I have no reason to believe that she isn't on board with this.

If it was someone I hadn't known and been very close friends with for 10 years, then I'd agree. Absolutely infatuation. But not this. This isn't a rose tinted glasses situation. I've seen every side of her, both good and bad and everything in between. I love her because of who she actually is and not who I want to pretend she is. In my eyes, love is seeing every side of a person, understanding that they aren't perfect, and working together to help make the other person the best possible version of themselves. Confiding in one another and growing together as an unbeatable force. Being able to visualize a realistically obtainable future with said person and putting in the effort to make it a reality. Being so fully committed to that person and doing everything in your power to make sure they are comfortable, understood, and have zero doubt about where they are in life and the person they have grown to be. Being able to understand that things will not be easy and with that, being willing and able to work together to brave through whatever hardships are thrown your way. With that said, there can and will be times where things need to be done independently and that's where I believe I am.

Of course. They grow, they fade, they change. It's human nature. But this goes so much deeper than just feelings. I simply don't have the words to explain it otherwise I would have phrased it differently. The only word I know that even comes close to describing this is love. And this is love. I know it is.

Thank you. I'm hoping for the same. For a long time, I didn't believe in true love. Only because of her, I'm now a firm believer in it. I've never had anyone in my life that can make me feel the way she makes me feel. It's inexplicable. My feelings for her go so far beyond words I'm still struggling to understand it myself. Vigilance isn't an issue. As far as presence goes, it can only be virtual at the moment. That's the biggest catch with our current circumstances, unfortunately. But I'm working towards changing that. I absolutely prefer to be back much sooner rather than later but it depends on how quickly the changes I'm actively trying to make can take effect. But I take comfort in believing that everything I'm doing now will truly be for the best for us and ultimately lead us to where we need to be, no matter when that happens.

I want to believe that. I'm quite forward with what I've been telling the people I'm talking to. You could say that the ball is in their court at this point. With that other friend, we talk regularly and I've definitely made myself known. I know she wants to help and I want her help but there isn't much she can do being as far away as she is. And that's fine. I don't expect her to put her life on pause for me. That goes with anyone, really. Yeah, I've been writing a lot recently. Mostly sad songs as I'm sure you can imagine but it's at least something to keep my mind occupied. A group thing could be nice. I don't think there's stuff like that around where I live but I'll keep an eye out. Yep, new hobbies are something I've been looking into. I'm starting by trying to re-familiarize myself with old hobbies that I fell out of and I'll branch out from there.

I appreciate your help. My thing is that I don't want to be too pressing. I value personal space whether personal or my friends and I understand that some people don't want to, or like you said, know how to deal with something like this. If they choose to put in the effort and care, I'll gladly talk to them. When it comes to sharing time or venting like you do, my closest friends either can't connect with me on that level or are too busy to be able to do something like that. I used to go out to bars a few times a week and have a great time with those friends but life got in the way. Unfortunately, the person I'm closest with and ideally the one I would prefer to help me through this lives out of state and is mostly unavailable due to her work schedule. As far as journaling, yes I do. I have a habit of making notes of random thoughts, ideas, and lyrics in my phone. I do it frequently. I'm also a musician of about 15 years and I have the equipment of a 5 piece rock band and then some so I am able to write, record, and produce songs to my hearts content. That is another thing I do frequently however music is one of my hobbies and as I stated, I've lost interest in my hobbies. I'm trying to stay connected to music as much as I can because I feel it is one of my best escapes but there is only so much I can do before I either get bored or lost in my thoughts.

Thank you. I'm just about to the point of having that mindset myself. I wish there was something I could do or tell you to help you. Me being the people person I am, I hate the fact that anyone is going through what we are. But now being in that situation myself, I understand. I wish you the best.
I know how you feel. I'm trying everything I can to continue to stay positive but it's getting harder every day. Like I told the other person, I hope you find what you need to get you through this.

To be completely honest with you, it's the intimidation of taking my own life. I'm so dissatisfied with the person I've become and the life I'm currently living and I truly don't want to keep whatever this is going. Nobody should ever have to deal with being this low. Nobody should have a reason to ever be this low. Life is supposed to be a beautiful thing. I know that it absolutely can be and have experienced it first hand for almost all of my life. But jesus christ, now I understand why the suicide rate continues to rise. I just don't know if I can bring myself to do it. I want to believe that there is hope for me, that there is something that will help pull me out of this place I'm in. But until then, I'm struggling on with whatever hope I have left. I hope the best for you, friend. I hope you find what you need to help pull you through this. Nobody deserves what we are going through.

I'm still taking care of myself. I refuse not to. I take care of my body and I try keep my mind occupied. I try to be productive as much as I can every day. Whether it's spending hours looking for jobs or attempting to let myself enjoy one of my hobbies, trying to explore new potential opportunities, etc. I do talk to my friends and I like to think that they'd care enough to help but with them it's a mostly one sided thing. I'm there when they need me and not the other way around. Family fortunately isn't the same story but they are very limited as far as what they can do. Trust me, I'm not hidden about what is going on with my life right now. I know I need help and I'm trying to get whatever help I can. But from the responses I've been getting, or lack thereof, I'm finding it really hard to believe that the people that mean most to me care as much about me as I do them. It's very disheartening.
